data.name: TMR simulator
data.detailed_description:
This is an unofficial game and has no connection with the creators of a very popular book/movie series featuring witches and wizards.

————————————————————————————————————————————————————

Summer, 1942. As expected, a gleaming insignia now adorns your robes, marking you as a rising authority among students. A new term begins. You must balance rigorous academics with burgeoning influence, all while peeling back the layers of your own origin.

Academics:​ The lecture halls fulfill basic duties; the archives offer pathways into far deeper knowledge. At the very least, those pivotal year-end certifications must not elude you.

Social Sphere:​ From exclusive faculty gatherings to chance encounters along the corridors, every connection can be shaped into an asset, bent toward your will.

Official Duties:​ You wield a small but openly recognized measure of power. While enforcing regulations, you may also indulge in certain privileges.

Leisure:​ The trinkets and warm brews of the nearby village offer fleeting comfort—though they scarcely compare to the amusement your “allies” provide.

The Hidden Truth:​ You have sensed it for ages. This year, you will finally tear away the last veil of secrecy. You have never doubted that you were born for greatness.

If all goes well, even the most vigilant mentor on staff will have no choice but to watch… as you become the abyss.
————————————————————————————————————————————————————
Gameplay Overview: Uncover the school's secrets through attending classes, reading, conducting research, exploring, and socializing. Drag cards to the action slots to perform tasks, and combine matching Knowledge, Energy, or Material cards to create new results. Manage your limited time wisely and make careful choices to reach your own unique ending.

data.short_description: TMR Simulator is a card-based life sim where you play as a student at a magical school. Manage your schedule, study forbidden knowledge, craft new insights from books and materials, explore the village, and correspond with classmates and professors—as ambition and darkness slowly take hold.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240, AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1GB), Radeon HD 7750 (1GB)
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
